chapter: Fish fries, passing the hat and district living
title: Fish fry jobs for mandolin, guitar and bass trios
summary: Willie Santiago and others played for pleasure, but trios earned two and a half to three dollars a man at private fish fries, where hosts also sold homebrew and bootleg.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, that's, that's about what I, uh, most I can remember now. What about, what about Willie Santiago? Did he play? Santiago was a guitar player, good, good. Did you ever hear him play mandolin? Yeah, he was a good mandolin player. Mm-hmm. Yeah, he was, he was great. Mm-hmm. Willie Santiago, yeah. Did he play mandolin in a band or a lot? No, no. Just, like we all, all of us was doing for sport, for playing, for pleasure like that, most, friends like that. Mm-hmm. Never did, we never did go out, we never made nothing on it, but, uh, we could, uh, we could form a little tree piece band with a mandolin guitar and bass like that. We'd make a lot of music with them tree pieces. We used to get them people to give fish fries to them a long time ago when them people give fish fries, on Saturday night. That's all they wanted, mandolin guitar and bass. Mm-hmm. That was plenty of music. They'd give me about two dollars and a half a man or three dollars, that's all we'd make. That was plenty money then. Yeah. And eight, and eight, and nine to one, eight to twelve, nine to one. Ten to two. Them people used to get them fish fries, you know, all Saturday night. And they used to make good money off of them fish fries. What do you mean that's in the private home or? Different homes, yeah, private homes. Downtown, uptown, all around. You see, they put a lamp out at night. Put a light lamp outside on the side of the house. There'll be a fish fry there on the, on the alley gate. And the people come in there. And the people come in there.

the crowd coming in here to do good business. They get back there to have liquid and during the provision time they made their own homebrew. That homebrew, they used to sell that homebrew too. And wine, whiskey, gin, anything like that. That bootleg stuff, you see. Yeah. Were you used to drink that? Yeah, sure man. Dude, I used to drink it. That was not drinking without any kink, without any seltzer or anything. You didn't need it. I didn't need it. That whole bootleg stuff was good too.
